notes.guidance_en: Keep written morphology separate from pronunciation. Before consonant-initial -게, the written stem-final ㅎ is retained in 이렇게 and 그렇게. Pronouncing ㅎ followed by ㄱ as [ㅋ] does not change their spelling to 이러케 or 그러케 and is not a written ㅎ-drop conjugation. In contrast, 이래 is an attested irregular written form of 이렇다. Explain the relevant formation, not a catalog of other forms.

sources.evidence_en: The official spelling examples retain stem-final ㅎ: 이렇게, 이렇고, 이렇지, 이렇거나.
ㅎ followed by ㄱ, ㄷ or ㅈ is pronounced with an aspirated consonant; this is a pronunciation rule.
The dictionary lists 이래 as an inflected written form.
